meta.title: Subprocessors | Everstead
meta.description: The third-party service providers Everstead uses to deliver the platform, what they do, where data is processed, and the transfer safeguards in place under UK GDPR.

intro.p1: To operate the Everstead platform we rely on a small number of trusted third-party providers ("subprocessors"). Each one has signed a Data Processing Agreement with {{company}} and provides appropriate safeguards under UK GDPR.
intro.p2: This page is the authoritative, up-to-date list. It is incorporated by reference into the <dpaLink>Adviser DPA</dpaLink> (clause 6) and the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

list.purpose: Managed PostgreSQL database, authentication, and encrypted file storage for vault content.
list.location: EU (Ireland), data hosted in Frankfurt region

list.purpose: Web hosting and serverless functions (Everstead website and API endpoints).
Subscription billing and payment processing. Card details never touch Everstead servers.
list.location: Ireland (EU). Stripe acts as independent controller for fraud prevention

list.purpose: Transactional email delivery (account verification, trial reminders, invoices, vault notifications).
Error monitoring and crash reporting. Receives technical error context only, no vault content.

AI-powered assistant, document scanning, and in-product guidance. Processes the messages and any documents or images a member chooses to submit to an AI feature, it is not given blanket access to a member’s vault, and runs only while AI features are switched on.
list.transferMechanism: UK IDTA / EU SCCs · processed under Anthropic’s commercial API terms; Anthropic does not train on Everstead traffic

changes.title: Changes to this list
changes.p1: We will notify customers (by email and a notice on this page) at least 30 days before adding or replacing a subprocessor. Adviser-plan customers may object to a change within that window; if we cannot resolve the objection, the customer may terminate their subscription for that reason without penalty.
changes.p2: Subscribe below to receive change notifications by email. We only use your address for subprocessor-change notices, never marketing.

form.error: Could not subscribe. Please try again.
form.successBody: A confirmation email is on its way. You can unsubscribe at any time from any notification email.

footer.note: {{company}} is the controller of Everstead member account data and the processor of vault content uploaded by members or by Advisers on behalf of their clients. For full details see the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink> and the <dpaLink>Adviser DPA</dpaLink>.
